events.statement: The first error related to payment processing appears at 2026-04-02T12:15:27Z: a payment is marked PENDING_RETRY due to mTLS handshake with bank-partner-api rejected.
The first TLS expiration error is logged at 2026-04-02T12:16:44Z, indicating the client certificate expired at 2026-04-02T12:15:00Z.
The bank_api_error_rate metric spikes to 100% starting at the 12:16 bucket and stays at 100% through the rest of the window, whereas the overall HTTP error_rate stays below 0.32%.
The error_rate dashboard for payment-service shows no abnormal rise (max 0.32%) despite the high bank_api_error_rate, explaining why the panel appears green while customers experience failures.

events.answer: Payments are failing because the mTLS client certificate used to talk to the bank-partner API expired at 12:15 UTC, causing TLS handshake rejections (seen in logs) and a 100% error rate on the bank API metric, while the overall HTTP error_rate remains low, so the dashboard stays green.
